items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: a cousin of Petrillo's named Cavallo had a band under a band shell right across from us.

ctx.x: Very fine. What kind of a bandstand? The bandstand.
Well, our bandstand was in the middle. And a cousin of Petrillo's named Cavallo had a band under a band shell right across from us. And we alternated. You alternated? Uh-huh.
Only white people in the audience?
